subject: Renewal kickoff: scale plan, term options & QBR slot
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acme.io>, Tina Alvarez <tina@acme.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal kickoff: scale plan, term options & QBR slot

Hi Jordan + Tina —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Per our discussion, I want to kick off the renewal and expansion plan so we can lock capacity, agree term options, and schedule a QBR to review traffic forecasts and runbook changes. High-level asks: 

- Confirm current forecasted peak token throughput for Oct–Dec (we have 2.5B tokens/day in side-channel).
- Decide whether you want to move to a 12-month commit with burst buckets or a 24-month stepped commit. I attached a mutual action plan with two term scenarios.
- Please share any procurement/PO timeline or legal contacts that need to be looped in.

Proposed next steps (feel free to edit):
1) You share final forecast and preferred term option by Tue 8/17.
2) Redwood sends a pricing sketch + capacity reservation note by Fri 8/20.
3) QBR to review runbook, capacity handoffs, and SLOs the week of 8/24.

Proposed QBR slots (PT): Tue 8/25 10–11am, Wed 8/26 1–2pm, Thu 8/27 9–10am. Tell me which works best and I’ll send an invite.

Attachments: ACME_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx (term scenarios + staffing), QBR_Agenda_draft.docx (rough agenda).

Kimberly/Marissa — I’ve looped you for pricing and legal touchpoints; can you review the MAP and add any notes by EOD Friday?

Thanks —
Aditya
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0147

From: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acme.io>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Tina Alvarez <tina@acme.io>
Date: 2026-08-11T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: scale plan, term options & QBR slot

Aditya —

Appreciate the clear plan. Quick answers from our side:
- Forecast: baseline 1.8B tokens/day, expected spike to 3.1B/day during holiday sales in Nov (internal model attached in my reply).
- Prefers 12-month commit with a 30% burst bucket rather than locking a 24-month stair-step. That gives us flexibility with new product launches.
- Procurement: I’ll get PO timing from our procurement lead, Tina (cc’d). Legal: I’ll introduce our counsel if/when we land on a pricing sketch.

QBR: Wed 8/26 1–2pm PT works for our execs.

Two asks: can Redwood include a short runbook excerpt on how failover to the alternative model variant would be handled during high traffic? Also, we need a simple unit-cost projection for the 12-month commit + burst (token and embedding calls separate).

Thanks —
Jordan
Jordan Smith
Head of Platform, Acme Payments
jordan.smith@acme.io

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acme.io>, Tina Alvarez <tina@acme.io>
Date: 2026-08-11T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: scale plan, term options & QBR slot

Thanks Aditya + Jordan — quick pricing notes from my side: 

- For a 12-month commit + 30% burst bucket we can offer a blended token price that steps down at 1.5B and 2.5B monthly thresholds. I’ll draft the sketch and include separate embedding pricing.
- I added two small operational asks to the MAP: (1) agreed pre-warm window for holiday spikes (48–72 hours) and (2) a documented fallback model variant mapping (this will be a short appendix).

I’ll circulate the pricing sketch by Thu 8/13 EOD so you have time to review before your internal procurement call.

Marissa — can you confirm SRE staffing overlap for the QBR and whether we should include our infra PO in the calendar invite?

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Ops, Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-08-12T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: scale plan, term options & QBR slot

Jordan / Tina —

Thanks for the fast reply and the preferred slot. Wed 8/26 1–2pm PT is confirmed — invite sent with a short draft agenda pulled from the QBR_Agenda_draft.docx.

What we’ll cover in the QBR (30–45 minute exec+ops):
- Traffic forecast and capacity reservation plan (Aditya + Jordan)
- Pricing sketch and commit/burst economics (Kim)
- Failover/runbook excerpt and fallback model mapping (Marissa + SRE)
- Timeline & procurement checkpoints (Jordan + Redwood procurement)

Marissa note: SRE will include the pre-warm play and failover summary; we’ll keep the appendix short and operational.

Action items after this thread: 
- Jordan: drop the internal forecast spreadsheet into the shared Drive link in the invite (by Mon 8/16).
- Kimberly: pricing sketch due Thu 8/13 EOD.
- Aditya: finalize MAP with the pre-warm and appendix notes and re-share by Fri 8/14.
- Marissa: attach the failover excerpt to the calendar invite once finalized.

Attachments: none in this reply; previous MAP + agenda still apply.

See you Wed 8/26 —
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
